title.zh: Sing-box 新一代通用代理平台入门全景：轻量核心架构、配置文件语法与客户端选型
title.en: Sing-box Universal Proxy Platform Primer: Lightweight Architecture, Config Syntax & Client Ecosystem

description.zh: 全面梳理 Sing-box 通用代理平台的核心架构与设计理念。深度解析其基于 Go 语言原生开发的高性能网络栈、严谨的 JSON 配置文件语法、与传统 Clash 的底层差异及跨平台客户端选型建议。
description.en: An exhaustive architectural exploration of Sing-box, the next-generation universal proxy platform. Covers Go-based high-concurrency network stack design, JSON configuration format, differences from Clash, and multi-platform client selection.
